strings.name: Mikko Hyppönen
strings.role: Sensofusion chief research officer and cybersecurity author
strings.summary: Finnish security researcher Mikko Hyppönen has long analyzed malware and discussed cybercrime, privacy and connected-device risks through talks and writing. In 2025 he moved from WithSecure to Sensofusion, applying threat-research experience to drone protection.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Transition announcement and planned start are separate. Thirty-four years of employment does not mean continuous CRO tenure; AI predictions and product performance are not independently verified findings.
strings.influence.rationale: Long-term malware and cybercrime research, technical work and public talks have advanced information-security awareness.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Company biography lists a vocational qualification in business IT and computer-science studies; the latter are not presented as a university degree.
strings.facts.f2.label: Current role
strings.facts.f2.value: Sensofusion chief research officer, not chief revenue officer; the company lists Europol and other advisory experience as previous roles.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Research and public communication
strings.highlights.h1.text: Uses malware experience to explain cybercrime and digital risks; research achievements include teamwork.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Privacy and device security
strings.highlights.h2.text: Books and talks examine connected devices, data collection and surveillance, helping audiences understand technological risks.
strings.timeline.t1.title: AI and security interview published
strings.timeline.t1.text: The Secure Disclosure publishes an interview on AI, malware and his career change; publication is not a verified recording date.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Announces move to Sensofusion
strings.timeline.t2.text: Tells Yle he will leave WithSecure and plans to start in August; current company biography confirms CRO service since 2025.
strings.timeline.t3.title: English book published
strings.timeline.t3.text: Wiley publishes If It’s Smart, It’s Vulnerable; this dates the English edition, not necessarily the original first edition.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Describes two research roles
strings.timeline.t4.text: In a CyberWire interview, identifies himself as WithSecure CRO and F-Secure principal research advisor.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Discusses surveillance at TEDxBrussels
strings.timeline.t5.text: Speaks about NSA surveillance and global trust, presenting his public views.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Discusses virus threats at TEDGlobal
strings.timeline.t6.text: Fighting viruses, defending the net addresses the evolution of malware and cybercrime.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Builds an early company website
strings.timeline.t7.text: His 2022 interview recalls helping establish the company’s first website; no claim to inventing websites or the internet.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joins Data Fellows
strings.timeline.t8.text: His career announcement recalls joining while studying computer science to reverse-engineer viruses.
